title: Thunder Rolls: Nashville Broadway, Bars & Bites
description:
Indulge in the ultimate Downtown Nashville escape with this sleek and stylish studio! Just 2.5 miles from the heart of Downtown Nashville & Broadway this end-unit gem puts you steps away from Nashville’s hottest spots—trendy restaurants, buzzing bars, cozy coffee shops, a liquor store, Hattie B’s, Vanderbilt, and the electrifying energy of Broadway. With a full kitchen and a location that’s as irresistible as the city itself, this is your perfect Nashville retreat!

The space
The space is not new. You will be booking for the location. You can walk to local hot spots, food, grocery, pharmacy and catch tons of live music! The building and parts of the unit show their age. Location is hard to beat.

Guest access
You will have access to the entire space.

Other things to note
No Animals Please. No smoking indoors. Thank you.

The space is not new. Some residents may smoke outside of their units. It is not allowed inside please. Thank you.
